name: ts_f7_loss_vs_accuracy
title: Held-out loss does not predict exact-match accuracy
caption: A low held-out loss is necessary but not sufficient for exact-match accuracy: Oriel and Meridian sit at loss levels similar to skills that score far higher, because a single wrong token anywhere in a long structured answer costs the whole row.
alt: Scatter plot of ten skills, held-out loss on a log x-axis against correct-of-225 on the y-axis, with skill names as labels.
